data.narrative:
Radical AI is a seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $55M to date. The company operates within a sector encompassing nine comparable firms—one public (ticker 277810.KQ) and eight private peers including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Bedrock Robotics. The founding team combines deep technical expertise with defense and venture experience: CEO Joseph Krause brings neuromorphic semiconductor research from Army Research Lab and deep-tech investment experience; President Jorge Colindres and Chief Scientific Officer Prof. Gerbrand Ceder (UC Berkeley, 25-year MIT tenure) anchor materials science and academic credibility.

The valuation analysis relies on a single applicable triangulation method. Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage progression, using the company's $55M total raised as a proxy base value. This yields an implied valuation of $138M. A peer-median approach was not feasible due to insufficient comparable data—while eight same-sector peers exist, none met the narrow filters for stage, adjacent-stage, or valuation-tier similarity, and using all-sector medians would introduce unwarranted noise.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $117M (low) to $158M (high), with $138M as the median point. Key uncertainties stem from the limited method count (one viable approach) and sparse peer comp data in this specific stage-sector intersection. Independent validation through customer pipeline, IP defensibility, or early revenue metrics would materially strengthen confidence in this range.
